verdict.rationale: Expensify documents its own API credentials: partnerUserID/partnerUserSecret pairs bound to a single Expensify account, which can be rotated by regenerating the secret. It also documents an OAuth2 authorization-code flow that issues short-lived access tokens to act on behalf of individual users, giving user-bound, time-limited access. Nothing shows the permissions themselves can be narrowed, so least-privilege scoping is unproven. Missing for 10: documented permission scopes or read-only/limited-action credentials, per-credential restriction to specific workspaces or operations, agent-specific credential issuance, and independent corroboration.
